Recruitment was completed ahead of schedule, positioning the company to report topline results in mid-2027.
Together, these milestones mark our transition from building a late-stage trial to executing toward a data readout and preparing for what comes next.
Reaching full enrollment is the culmination of a coordinated effort by patients, investigators, and clinical teams, and it begins the countdown to topline data expected in mid-2027.

Our U.S. dual listing has a strategic purpose: to broaden and diversify our investor base, raise Vicore’s profile among US healthcare investors, and strengthen our position to create long-term value as we approach our readout.
We ended the period in a strong financial position, with a cash runway extending into the second half of 2028 that provides clear financial visibility through our mid-2027 readout.
